EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Well, I do believe I'll be heading
home. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Thanks for having me
over, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bueno, me temo que ya es hora
de volver a casa. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Muchas
gracias por invitarme, amor!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bien. Je pense que je vais y aller,
maintenant. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je te remercie encore
d'avoir bien voulu me recevoir.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si è fatto tardi. Devo tornare
a casa! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ti ringrazio molto
per la tua ospitalità, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sanırım artık eve dönsem iyi olacak. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Beni
ağırladığın için teşekkürler, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Well, I don't want to overstay my
welcome, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}so I'll say good-bye,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Creo que ya he abusado bastante
de tu amabilidad. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Espero que me
invites otra vez, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je ne veux surtout pas m'imposer
davantage, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}alors je crois que je vais
te dire au revoir maintenant.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Şey, misafirliği fazla uzatmak istemem, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}o yüzden
hoşça kal diyeyim, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'd love to stay, but I must be
going, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. It was great
seeing your place!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je serais ravie de rester, mais c'est
déjà l'heure de rentrer,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
J'ai été enchantée d'avoir eu
l'opportunité de visiter ta demeure.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mi piacerebbe restare, ma si è fatto
tardi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. Sono contenta
di aver visto casa tua!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kalmak isterdim ama artık gitmeliyim, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
Evini görmek çok güzeldi!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Comment ? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu dois t'en aller,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Dans ce cas, je pense
que je ferais mieux d'y aller aussi.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Leaving, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I suppose I
should be going too. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Thanks for
letting me visit, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Sales, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Supongo que
yo también debería. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Tengo otras
cosas que hacer, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Tu dois partir, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dans ce
cas,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} je suppose que je ferais mieux
de te laisser.
Merci de m'avoir fait visiter ton
intérieur, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Te ne stai andando, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Suppongo di dover andare anch'io.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Grazie di tutto, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Gidiyor musun, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Benim
de gitmem gerek sanırım.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ziyaret etmeme izin verdiğin için teşekkürler,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
